description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Located within a mile of Beach Access* Borders Camp Helen State Park* 1 mile to 30Avenue for shopping, entertainment, and dining* Take the new underground tunnel from 30Avenue directly to 30A for more beach accesses, shopping, and dining* 4 Bikes Included! * Outdoor Grilling and Lounge Area in a spacious backyard* Community pool and dock for access to Lake Powell* Mile to some of the best restaurants in 30A! - Cuvee 30A, amici 30A, Aja 30A, and Canopy Road Café* less than a mile to Destin Seafood Market, Ghost Pizza, Shaka Sushi, and the Donut Hole.* Located in beautiful Inlet Beach* Network of nature trails around Lake Powell* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * Welcome to Grande Pointe 142 – LiveSea 30A, a beautiful 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom retreat that perfectly blends comfort, style, and coastal charm. Designed with relaxation in mind, the open-concept layout seamlessly connects the spacious living room, dining area, and gourmet kitchen, featuring high-end stainless-steel appliances, elegant quartzite countertops, and a convenient breakfast bar. On the first floor, you’ll find a cozy queen guest bedroom. Upstairs, the luxurious master suite boasts a king bed and private bath, while two additional guest rooms include a second fun queen-over-queen bunk room bedroom and a king bed with a connected shared bathroom. With accommodations for up to 10 guests, this inviting home ensures everyone has the space to unwind and enjoy their stay. Step outside to the covered back balcony and discover an outdoor oasis complete with a gas grill—perfect for evening gatherings. For a truly unforgettable experience, paddle a kayak across the scenic Powell Lake, glide under the charming bridge at Phillips Inlet, and explore the stunning coastline beyond. Start making unforgettable memories at LiveSea 30A—your coastal escape awaits!Grande Pointe at Inlet Beach offers an exclusive coastal community of upscale homes across from Camp Helen State Park and overlooking Lake Powell. Spanning over 30 acres, the beautiful homes in Grande Pointe have been integrated into the natural environment, keeping much of the native foliage and large trees. The result is a charming and private waterfront village in a lush, natural setting. A lakefront pavilion makes the perfect meeting place for special events and accessing nature paths leading to Lake Powell, the community dock, and the swimming pool.Bed Setup:1st Floor:Guest Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King BedGuest Bedroom 2: 2 Queen-over-Queen BunkbedsGuest Bedroom 3: King BedArea Attractions:Serving as the gateway to 30A, 30Avenue is located at the intersection of Highway 98 and the east entry of famed Scenic Highway 30A. It is a lifestyle center offering exceptional restaurants, boutique shopping, health and beauty services, all within easy walking distance of Inlet, Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys beaches.Services include a med spa, yoga, beauty lounge, and more! Boutique shopping and loads of delicious food, including:Aja elevated Asian Kitchen - Master Chef Tom Catherall has created a menu showcasing elevated Asian cuisines. The menu includes a variety of authentic dishes such as sushi, sashimi, stir-fries, and noodle dishes. Amici Italian Kitchen offering authentic Italian cuisine with a flair for celebration and uses only the best ingredients to prepare fresh and handmade dishes cooked to order in a lively exhibition kitchen.Amigos' authentic Mexican cuisine with a flair for celebration. amigo’s 30A Mexican Kitchen brings delicious Mexican food to 30A in a welcoming, family-style atmosphere.Canopy Road Cafe specializes in traditional breakfast and lunch fare, with some fresh, funky, and innovative twists.Cuvee30A - Savor celebrity Chef Tim Creehan’s award-winning signature dishes, such as Amy Grant’s Seared Tuna Rare and Vince Gill’s Pecan-Crusted Grouper in a stunning venue at the junction of 30A and Highway 98. The DiRoNA awarded restaurant also features their “Best of the Emerald Coast” voted Happy Hour and a world-class Wine List, awarded the 30A area’s only Wine Spectator Best of Award of Excellence 2016-2022. Goatfeathers at 30Avenue is your local favorite seafood restaurant, fish market, and specialty store. Southern Charm Coffee & Gather with the sweet and rich aromas from our Fresh Baked Desserts and Our custom Roast In- House Decadent Dessert Blend Coffee.Powell Lake straddles Walton County and Bay County and borders much of Camp Helen State Park on the Gulf side and the development of Wild Heron on the north side. It is the largest of the coastal dune lakes in Walton County and allows motorboats and jet skis. Access the lake at Camp Helen State Park, a county park at N. Walton Lakeshore Drive, or the Lake Powell boat ramp in Bay County. Approx 650 acres.Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! Read less
